html:
Quest Giver: Ectoplastics Distributor

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to Level 7 of the Shadow's Embrace, find the ectoplastics distributor, and use the counterfeit King's Coin to make an exchange.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Ectoplastics Distributor

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: King's Coin Counterfeit Conspiracy, Part 7

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go to Level 7 of the Shadow's Embrace, find the ectoplastics distributor, and use the counterfeit King's Coin to make an exchange.

Offer:

I've been pondering on the Haxhaxors. It's well known that they are the gadget-makers of the Guild of Shadows, but lately they seem to be following their own agenda.

For example, they were generating their own revenue by selling counterfeit King's Coins. In turn, they invested their ill-gotten wealth into the ectoplastics industry. Someone more clever than I might consider the Haxhaxors are planning on using ectoplastics for their next nefarious device.

Coincidentally, I am also looking to invest in ectoplastics! Do me a favor, would you? Take my King's Coin and make an exchange with an ectoplastics distributor. Perhaps there may be one on Level 7. *wink!*

Turn-in:

Good evenin' sir! I'm an ectoplastics distributor, I am. I'm specializing in programmable engines, if you please. Would sir care to buy an EPU? They're on special this day, they are! Only one single Coin of the King!

Objectives:

  • Trade a fake King's Coin for ectoplastics ×1

Client level range: 50–100
